title: Normal-R4 swing provider readiness + stale ops text
claim_limits: Normal-R4 slots are READY for a provider and prove the full build/connect/fetch/decide/disconnect path on a fake broker. The provider is OFF by default. NKD still has no Track 1 slot, so this is not a full Track 1 route and no shadow period yet covers four sleeves.

blocker_found_and_fixed.what: run_live_day_track1's --sleeve argument listed choices [None, roska4_calm, roska4_stress]; roska4_swing was not among them
blocker_found_and_fixed.effect: the scheduler built an argv argparse REJECTS. All 23 swing slots would have failed at parse time, every day, before any of the route ran
blocker_found_and_fixed.why_5m_b_missed_it: the Stage 5M-B suite called observe_live_slot directly. The captured argv was correct; nothing drove it through main()
blocker_found_and_fixed.fix: choices derived from tp.WINDOWS_ET, so a new sleeve cannot be rejected by a list nobody updated
blocker_found_and_fixed.proof: python -m global_index.run_live_day_track1 --sleeve roska4_swing ... now parses and reaches the route's own ledger_not_configured refusal

provider_staging.unrecognised: raises at scheduler build time; the scheduler does not start
provider_staging.scope: roska4_swing only; Calm and Stress keep ibkr and are not reachable by it
provider_staging.resolved: once per session, at job registration
provider_staging.why_not_switched_on_now: the premise that freezing legacy frees the 14:05-15:55 window is FALSE. STOP_TRADING halts new entries only: runner.run_day checks it AFTER the slot has spawned, connected on IBKR clientId 1, fetched bars for every instrument, rolled contracts and run the exit and reconcile checks. Freezing legacy removes the trading, not the load. The collision is unchanged and still unmeasured

route_guards_that_caught_the_fixture.what: a provider without history has nothing to append to
history must be tz-aware; a naive frame was not loaded by frozen_frame()
the fake returned the whole session regardless of `through`; a real broker trims
the fake feed and the frozen half disagreed on 276 of 276 shared timestamps
